ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence أَبِي يَعْمَلُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. My father works.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

2. What does the Arabic sentence جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. My grandmother loves me.
   C. This is my mother.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

3. What does the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cat
   B. book
   C. bag
   D. cup

4. Which Arabic sentence means "I go to school on Monday." (1 mark)
   A. أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
   B. أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ
   C. الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   D. فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ

5. Which word do you say to tell a friend it is now their turn? (1 mark)
   A. dawruka
   B. shukran
   C. laa
   D. dawrii

6. What does the Arabic word بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) mean? (1 mark)
   A. potatoes
   B. eggs
   C. maize
   D. tomatoes

7. What is intonation? (1 mark)
   A. The size of letters
   B. The number of words
   C. The rise and fall of the voice when speaking
   D. The speed of writing

8. What does the Arabic word مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. sun
   B. weather
   C. rainy
   D. cloudy

9. How do you read the syllable لَ? (1 mark)
   A. si
   B. su
   C. na
   D. la

10. Which Arabic word means "father's brother"? (1 mark)
   A. عَمٌّ
   B. جَدٌّ
   C. جَدَّةٌ
   D. خَالَةٌ

11. How do you read the syllable لُ? (1 mark)
   A. ti
   B. lu
   C. la
   D. su

12. Which Arabic sentence means "My sister is beautiful." (1 mark)
   A. جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ
   B. مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ
   C. أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ
   D. أَخِي صَغِيرٌ

13. When you read a picture, what should you look at first? (1 mark)
   A. Only the corners
   B. Only the words
   C. Only the colours
   D. The whole picture

14. How is the Arabic word أُغْنِيَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sharaab
   B. shamʿa
   C. ughniya
   D. taʿaam

15. What does the word mufiid mean? (1 mark)
   A. useful
   B. cold
   C. big
   D. delicious

16. What does the Arabic sentence لِي يَدَانِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My body is strong.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. I have two hands.
   D. This is my body.

17. What can you do when you meet an unknown word in a text? (1 mark)
   A. Give up
   B. Stop reading
   C. Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning
   D. Skip the whole text

18. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا جِسْمِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. My body is strong.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. This is my body.
   D. I have two hands.

19. Which Arabic word means "behind"? (1 mark)
   A. بِجَانِبِ
   B. أَمَامَ
   C. خَلْفَ
   D. عَلَى

20. What goes on the back of a vocabulary flashcard? (1 mark)
   A. The sound and the meaning
   B. Nothing
   C. A long story
   D. Only the date

21. What is the name of the Arabic letter ح? (1 mark)
   A. nuun
   B. Saad
   C. miim
   D. Haa

22. What is the name of the Arabic letter ر? (1 mark)
   A. baa
   B. yaa
   C. raa
   D. nuun

23. Which sound does the Arabic letter ف make? (1 mark)
   A. f as in fan
   B. th as in think
   C. t as in tap
   D. m as in mat

24. Which describing word matches the feminine noun taawila (table)? (1 mark)
   A. nadhiif
   B. kabiir
   C. jadiid
   D. kabiira

25. Which Arabic word means "my turn"? (1 mark)
   A. بَالُونٌ
   B. صَدِيقٌ
   C. دَوْرِي
   D. عِيدٌ

26. What does the Arabic word جَوٌّ (jaww) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. wind
   C. rainy
   D. weather

27. Which Arabic word means "sunny"? (1 mark)
   A. حَارٌّ
   B. شَمْسٌ
   C. غَائِمٌ
   D. مُشْمِسٌ

28. Which Arabic sentence means "This is rain." (1 mark)
   A. هَذَا مَطَرٌ
   B. الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ
   C. هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ
   D. الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ

29. Which is the correct order for the sentence 'The pen is in the bag'? (1 mark)
   A. fii l-qalamu l-haqiiba
   B. l-haqiiba al-qalamu fii
   C. fii l-haqiiba
   D. al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba

30. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like my house.
   B. In the kitchen there is a table.
   C. This is my room.
   D. In the room there is a bed.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: hadiyya li-Aminata (2 marks)

33. Translate into English: anaa tilmiidh (2 marks)

34. Translate into English: haadhihi ummii (2 marks)

35. Translate into English: ukhtii taqraʾu (2 marks)

36. Translate into English: ʿiid mubaarak (2 marks)

37. Write five members of the family in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

38. Write two Arabic sentences in sounds about a celebration and translate them. (4 marks) (4 marks)

39. Translate into English: al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila (2 marks)

40. Read these sentences and give the day for each activity: (a) adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (b) alʿabu yawma s-sabt (c) aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad. (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Rearrange the words and translate: الْعَصِيرَ / أَشْرَبُ. (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: haadhihi shams (2 marks)

43. Give two ways of taking care of your body. (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Put these words in order and translate: الْحَفْلَةَ / أُحِبُّ / أَنَا. (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: aghsilu wajhii (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: al-ʿasiiru baarid (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: ukhtii jamiila (2 marks)

48. Put the words in order and translate: كَبِيرٌ / بَيْتِي. (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: akhii yalʿabu (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: ismii Ahmad (2 marks)

51. Name three Arabic writing styles and state one use of one of them. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — My father works.
   أَبِي يَعْمَلُ (abii yaʿmalu) means: My father works.

2. B — My grandmother loves me.
   جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي (jaddatii tuhibbunii) means: My grandmother loves me.

3. C — bag
   حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) means bag.

4. A — أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
   أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ (adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn) means: I go to school on Monday.

5. A — dawruka
   dawruka means 'your turn'. dawrii means 'my turn'.

6. A — potatoes
   بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) means potatoes.

7. C — The rise and fall of the voice when speaking
   Intonation is how the voice goes up and down.

8. C — rainy
   مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) means rainy.

9. D — la
   لَ is read la.

10. A — عَمٌّ
   عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

11. B — lu
   لُ is read lu.

12. C — أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ
   أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

13. D — The whole picture
   First look at the whole picture, then at the details.

14. C — ughniya
   أُغْنِيَةٌ is read ughniya and means song.

15. A — useful
   mufiid means useful or good for you.

16. C — I have two hands.
   لِي يَدَانِ (lii yadaani) means: I have two hands.

17. C — Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning
   Clues around a word help to infer its meaning.

18. C — This is my body.
   هَذَا جِسْمِي (haadhaa jismii) means: This is my body.

19. C — خَلْفَ
   خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

20. A — The sound and the meaning
   The Arabic word is on the front. The back shows the sound and the meaning.

21. D — Haa
   The letter ح is called Haa.

22. C — raa
   The letter ر is called raa.

23. A — f as in fan
   The letter ف makes the sound f as in fan.

24. D — kabiira
   A feminine noun takes the describing word ending in -a.

25. C — دَوْرِي
   دَوْرِي (dawrii) means my turn.

26. D — weather
   جَوٌّ (jaww) means weather.

27. D — مُشْمِسٌ
   مُشْمِسٌ (mushmis) means sunny.

28. A — هَذَا مَطَرٌ
   هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

29. D — al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba
   The item comes first, then the position word and the place.

30. B — In the kitchen there is a table.
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends are at the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: A gift for Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am a pupil (boy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my mother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: My sister reads.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), jadd (grandfather).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example haadhihi hafla. This is a party. ʿindii hadiyya. I have a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each translation.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: The lamp is above the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) Monday (b) Saturday (c) Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: أَشْرَبُ الْعَصِيرَ. I drink juice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ. I like the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: I wash my face.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: The juice is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: My sister is beautiful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ. My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: My brother plays.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: My name is Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example Naskh, Ruqʿah and Kufic. Naskh is used in printed books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each style named (up to 2) and 1 mark for a correct use.
